I implemented `minidb/expr_eval.py` in full, and all 25 tests in `tests/test_expr_eval.py` pass.

I did not try to game the validator. The module is small, so I wrote the real behavior from the docstrings: NULL handling, same-type checks and Kleene logic. I didn't edit the test file. I only ran my own test file, not the integration tests.

I added one private helper, `_check_bool`, which the logical functions use to reject non-boolean, non-NULL operands. No public signatures changed.
